title: Cold rebuild: the hidden dependency
summary: Make a config that only worked on one laptop apply on a clean machine, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove it stuck. In *Providers, resources and the graph* you fixed a configuration whose data source read a
file before anything had written it. Do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution**. The checks
are the ones you passed the first time.
Pulling a fix out of memory is what makes it stay there. If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again

steps.prompt: Which change makes Terraform see that the data source must wait for the resource that writes the file?
options: Set the data source's `filename` to the resource's `filename` attribute (a reference)
Move the data source below the resource in the file
steps.explain: Only references (and `depends_on`) create edges in the graph. Block order, file order and parallelism do not.

steps.title: It only works on Sam's laptop, cold
prompt: `~/infra/site` fails to plan on a clean machine. Make it apply in an empty folder (the check copies your `.tf` files
to one), and apply it in `~/infra/site` too. Do not create files by hand.
From memory: no hints this time.
